gallery.filename: 2016.10 - 'Floating Fall in & on the water' - Amsterdam photos, in the sun-light of October- geotagged free urban picture, in public domain Commons CCO; city photography by Fons Heijnsbroek, The Netherlands (30568586752).png
gallery.title: File:2016.10 - 'Floating Fall in & on the water' - Amsterdam photos, in the sun-light of October- geotagged free urban picture, in public domain Commons CCO; city photography by Fons Heijnsbroek, The Netherlands (30568586752).png
gallery.description:
'A close view on a construction-site' - Amsterdam in photos.
View on a yellowing urban trees in the Fall of the city, with their reflections in the water. Location is at the street Kattenburgergracht along the canal-water of the Nieuwe Vaart, in the sunlight of late October.
At the utter left in the picture a floating garden on the water, as you can find more of them in Amsterdam. This one was a former garden of a houseboat, recently destroyed by fire. The floating garden stayed here in the water. 

Urban photos of The Netherlands; a geotagged and free download city picture in the public domain / Commons, CCO; Dutch photographer Fons Heijnsbroek, Autumn 2016 The Netherlands.

gallery.filename: 2016.10 - Amsterdam photo; Urban trees in Fall along the reflecting canal-water of De Nieuwe Vaart - geo-tagged free urban picture, in public domain Commons CCO; Dutch urban photography by Fons Heijnsbroek, The Netherlands (30183352652).png
gallery.title: File:2016.10 - Amsterdam photo; Urban trees in Fall along the reflecting canal-water of De Nieuwe Vaart - geo-tagged free urban picture, in public domain Commons CCO; Dutch urban photography by Fons Heijnsbroek, The Netherlands (30183352652).png
gallery.description:
Amsterdam Photos - urban trees in Fall with a reflecting house-boat, along the canal-water of De Nieuwe Vaart.
Autumn is starting and the leaves of the trees in this picture got colored in yellow-green, orange-brown and red-brown.
It is always remarkable that the reflections in the water generates quite other and often much stronger colors then the real things above the water-surface.

Urban photography of The Netherlands; a geotagged and free download city photo in the public domain / Commons CCO, Dutch photographer Fons Heijnsbroek, Autumn 2016.

gallery.description:
Amsterdam, photo of Urban nature in the water - a huge coot nest made from rubbish and waste, built by an urban coot (difficult to discover in the photo: black body and white spot right on the head, and  wide open beaks - ) in the canal water of Amsterdam city. I don't remember the place. Urban fauna.

Urban photography of Amsterdam, The Netherlands; a geotagged and free download picture in the public domain / Commons - Dutch photographer Fons Heijnsbroek, September 2016.
